# @gears-frontx/framework

> Plugin-based application framework for FrontX SDK. Orchestrates SDK packages into cohesive applications with MFE (Microfrontend) support.

Part of the FrontX Framework Layer (L2) - depends on all SDK packages (@gears-frontx/state, @gears-frontx/mfes, @gears-frontx/gts-plugin, @gears-frontx/api, @gears-frontx/i18n). Owns layout slices.

## Core API

- [createGears FrontX](https://frontx.dev/docs/framework/create): The one way to create an app (`.use(...).build()`); a runtime builds exactly one
- [presets](https://frontx.dev/docs/framework/presets): Pre-configured plugin arrays (full, minimal); `full()` adds microfrontends only when `config.microfrontends` is supplied and auth only when `config.auth` is supplied, `minimal()` is themes only

## Available Plugins

| Plugin | Provides |
|--------|----------|
| `themes()` | themeRegistry, changeTheme action |
| `layout()` | header, footer, menu, sidebar, popup, overlay state |
| `microfrontends()` | mfeRegistry (MFE-enabled), MFE actions, selectors, domain constants |
| `i18n()` | i18nRegistry, setLanguage action |
| `effects()` | Core effect coordination |
| `mock()` | mockSlice, toggleMockMode action |

## Quick Start

```typescript
// A runtime builds exactly one app: the two compositions below are
// alternatives, choose one per runtime.

// Alternative: compose plugins
import { createGears FrontX, effects, themes, layout, microfrontends, i18n } from '@gears-frontx/framework';
const app = createGears FrontX()
  .use(effects())
  .use(themes())
  .use(layout())
  .use(microfrontends(config))
  .use(i18n())
  .build();

// Alternative: use the full preset, with microfrontends support
import { createGears FrontX, presets } from '@gears-frontx/framework';
const app = createGears FrontX().useAll(presets.full({ microfrontends: config })).build();

// Access MFE-enabled registry
app.mfeRegistry.registerDomain(screenDomain, containerProvider);
await app.mfeRegistry.registerExtension(homeExtension);

// Access MFE actions
app.actions.loadExtension('home');
app.actions.mountExtension('home');
app.actions.unmountExtension('home');

// Access theme and i18n actions
app.actions.changeTheme({ themeId: 'dark' });
app.actions.setLanguage({ language: 'es' });
```

## MFE Plugin

The `microfrontends()` plugin provides:

### MFE Actions

```typescript
import {
  loadExtension,        // Load extension code
  mountExtension,       // Mount extension into domain
  unmountExtension,     // Unmount extension from domain
  registerExtension,    // Register extension dynamically
  unregisterExtension,  // Unregister extension
} from '@gears-frontx/framework';
```

### MFE Selectors

```typescript
import {
  selectExtensionState,       // Get extension state
  selectRegisteredExtensions, // Get all registered extensions
  selectExtensionError,       // Get extension error
} from '@gears-frontx/framework';
```

### Domain Constants

```typescript
import {
  Gears FrontX_SCREEN_DOMAIN,   // 'screen'
  Gears FrontX_SIDEBAR_DOMAIN,  // 'sidebar'
  Gears FrontX_POPUP_DOMAIN,    // 'popup'
  Gears FrontX_OVERLAY_DOMAIN,  // 'overlay'
  screenDomain,         // ExtensionDomain object
  sidebarDomain,        // ExtensionDomain object
  popupDomain,          // ExtensionDomain object
  overlayDomain,        // ExtensionDomain object
} from '@gears-frontx/framework';
```

### Action Constants

```typescript
import {
  Gears FrontX_ACTION_LOAD_EXT,     // 'frontx.action.load_ext'
  Gears FrontX_ACTION_MOUNT_EXT,    // 'frontx.action.mount_ext'
  Gears FrontX_ACTION_UNMOUNT_EXT,  // 'frontx.action.unmount_ext'
} from '@gears-frontx/framework';
```

### Shared Property Constants

```typescript
import {
  Gears FrontX_SHARED_PROPERTY_THEME,     // 'frontx.shared.theme'
  Gears FrontX_SHARED_PROPERTY_LANGUAGE,  // 'frontx.shared.language'
} from '@gears-frontx/framework';
```

## Plugin Composition Pattern

```typescript
import { createGears FrontX, microfrontends, gtsPlugin } from '@gears-frontx/framework';

// MFE-enabled app
const app = createGears FrontX()
  .use(microfrontends({ typeSystem: gtsPlugin })) // Provides mfeRegistry (MFE-enabled), MFE actions and domain management
  .build();

// Access MFE features
await app.mfeRegistry.registerExtension(extension);
app.actions.mountExtension(extensionId);
```

## MFE Types

```typescript
import type {
  Extension,              // Extension definition
  ScreenExtension,        // Screen-specific extension (derived type)
  ExtensionDomain,        // Domain definition
  MfeHandler,             // Abstract handler for MFE lifecycle
  MfeBridgeFactory,       // Abstract factory for bridges
  ParentMfeBridge,        // Parent bridge interface
  ChildMfeBridge,         // Child bridge interface
  LifecycleStage,         // Lifecycle stage definition
  ActionsChain,           // Actions chain for lifecycle hooks
} from '@gears-frontx/framework';
```

## Concrete MFE Implementations

```typescript
import { MfeHandlerMF } from '@gears-frontx/framework';  // Module Federation handler
import { gtsPlugin } from '@gears-frontx/framework';     // GTS type validation plugin
```
